name.ja: 代数的マルチグリッド（AMG）
この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: 各行の最大非対角係数に対する相対強度からグラフを作り、貪欲な星型集約と余剰節点の隣接集約への付着で暫定補間Tを作ります。P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T、ω=4/(3ρ̄)、ρ̄はD⁻¹Aの絶対行和上界です。粗演算子はPᵀAP。前後2回のJacobi平滑化と最終小行列の直接解を用います。これは採用した小規模SA変種であり、原著の全構築法や収束定理の再現ではありません。
note.en: A graph based on row-relative off-diagonal strength supplies greedy star aggregates; leftover nodes attach to adjacent aggregates. Smooth tentative T via P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T with ω=4/(3ρ̄), where ρ̄ bounds the absolute row sums of D⁻¹A. Coarse operators are PᵀAP. V-cycles use two pre/post Jacobi sweeps and a terminal dense direct solve. This is a small adopted SA variant, not every construction or convergence theorem in the original paper.

note.ja: Householder反射を左から蓄積してRを上三角化し、Qを構成します。Jacobi SVDは列対の内積を小さくする直交回転を繰り返し、回転した列の長さを特異値とします。AᵀAを作って固有値を求める方法ではありません。最小二乗はQRの後退代入、階数落ちでは打切りSVDで求めます。
note.en: Householder reflectors triangularize R while accumulating Q. The SVD repeatedly rotates column pairs toward orthogonality and uses their resulting lengths as singular values; it does not diagonalize AᵀA. Least squares uses triangular back substitution for QR and truncated compact SVD for deficient rank.

note.ja: 対の重心速度と相対速度の大きさを保持し、相対速度の方向を球面上で一様に選びます。roundは物理時刻ではなく衝突演算の回数です。 D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>と置くと、ランダムな相方の平均で重心の異方性が(N−2)/(2(N−1))倍になり、散乱後の相対方向の異方性期待値はゼロになるため、保存した期待減衰率が得られます。
note.en: Preserve pair center-of-mass velocity and relative speed, then choose the new relative direction uniformly on the sphere. Rounds count collision operations and are not calibrated physical time. For D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>, averaging a random partner multiplies the center-of-mass anisotropy by (N−2)/(2(N−1)); isotropic postcollision relative directions contribute zero expected anisotropy.

note.ja: 解析平均・分散・CDFの指定7点・正側占有と照合。各鎖の占有率と峰間遷移、rank/folded split Rhat、bulk/tail/mean・modeindicator ESS、鎖内だけのACF/ESSを記録。分散trapped鎖はpooled分布が良くてもRhat/多鎖ESSで失敗、same-mode鎖はRhatが良くても既知標的に失敗する対照です。scenario passはこの期待失敗を検出できた意味です。CDF差は指定点最大でKS全域距離・IID検定p値ではありません。
note.en: Compare with analytic moments, seven declared CDF points and positive occupancy. Record per-chain occupancies/transitions, rank/folded split Rhat, bulk/tail/mean and mode-indicator ESS, and within-only ACF/ESS. Dispersed trapped chains can have a good pooled distribution yet fail between-chain diagnostics; same-mode chains can have reassuring Rhat yet fail the known target. A control scenario passes when its intended failure is detected. CDF error is a declared-point maximum, not whole-line KS distance or an IID-test p-value.

note.ja: 原著式から独自実装。odd長は中央1標本を落としてsplit、平均順位のBlom式は訂正済みS+1/4、fold後再rank、最大Rhatを採用。bulk ESSはrank split、tail ESSは元の全鎖のType7分位点を先に求めた≤indicatorをsplit。Geyer initial-positive/monotoneと宣言した端点処理・tau≥1/log10(total)を用い、反相関ESSをNへclipしません。
note.en: Original equation-based implementation: split with the odd center dropped, average-tie Blom ranks using corrected S+1/4, re-rank folded deviations, and take the larger Rhat. Bulk ESS uses rank-split draws; tail ESS first determines Type7 quantiles on original full draws, then splits <= indicators. Use initial-positive/monotone pairs, declared endpoint handling and tau>=1/log10(total), without clipping antithetic ESS to N.

note.ja: Lie–Trotterは拡散h→反応h、Strangは拡散h/2→反応h→拡散h/2。どちらも更新後の状態を次へ渡します。拡散は2次中心FD行列の指数をFFTで厳密適用、反応は同じ陰的中点則・Newton公差2e−13・上限12評価を使用。反応流は厳密解ではなく2次近似です。クリッピング・自動刻み変更・代替解法への切替を行わず、未収束は失敗にします。
note.en: Lie–Trotter uses diffusion(h) then reaction(h); Strang uses diffusion(h/2), reaction(h), diffusion(h/2), always passing the updated state. Both apply the exact exponential of the centered-FD diffusion matrix by FFT and the same implicit-midpoint reaction/Newton tolerance 2e−13 with at most 12 residual evaluations. The reaction flow is a second-order approximation, not exact. No clipping, adaptive steps or fallback; nonconvergence is failure.

note.ja: Rusanov流束とSSPRK2（Heun）を使用します。平面・円筒は従来の区分定数再構築、球は保存量を体積重心の周りにMUSCL型線形再構築し、内部セルは重心間距離によるminmod傾きを使い、両端の境界セルは傾き0とします。各セル共通の係数θで左右面の全保存量傾きを縮小し、密度と内部エネルギーの面状態を検査します。セル平均の修正・圧力seed・floorは使いません。波速、Rusanov流束、数値応力P*=F_mom−((u_L+u_R)/2)F_massは同じ面状態から計算し、幾何CFLはV/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R)、指定値.35です。球では線形面応力の∫2rP*(r)drを厳密積分、平面・円筒は旧算術平均求積を保持します。反射面は再構築後の面状態を偶奇反転し、外側の冷たい流入は物理流束で与えます。各RK段の有限性・密度・内部エネルギーを検査し、不正なら失敗を記録します。
note.en: Rusanov flux with SSPRK2 (Heun). Planar/cylindrical runs retain piecewise-constant reconstruction. Spherical runs reconstruct conserved variables linearly around volume centroids with minmod slopes based on centroid distances in interior cells and zero slopes in the two boundary cells. A single theta per cell scales all conserved slopes at both faces to check face density/internal energy. Cell means are never corrected and no pressure seed/floor is used. Wave speeds, Rusanov flux and numerical stress P*=F_mom-((u_L+u_R)/2)F_mass use the same face states. The geometric CFL V/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R) uses the prescribed .35. Spherical source quadrature exactly integrates the face-linear numerical stress against 2r dr; planar/cylindrical runs keep the old arithmetic rule. Reconstructed reflection faces use even/odd parity, with physical cold inflow at the outer face. Every RK stage is checked and invalid states cause a retained failure.

note.ja: 旧平面・円筒の受入基準と59判定を保持し、球の追加基準・入力・ソースhashを初回の球PDE実行前に保存します。初回の円筒不合格はソース・全8本の診断ログ・不合格サマリーを保持し、同じ基準で面応力版を再検証した履歴です。厳密保存量セル平均は衝撃をまたぐ積分を分割し、p(平均U)と平均pを分けます。固定版LANL ExactPackの独立解析照合はd=1/2/3を含みます。球の新規PDE系列では全域r²重みL1/L2/L∞、原点を含むr≤.70rsの密度L1、原点・衝撃・plateauを別測定。各段の境界流入による離散保存収支と、連続解析総量との差を分け、M_h−M_exact=Σdt³/6、E_h−E_exact=Σdt³/12というSSPRK2境界求積の恒等式を検査します。 最初の球対称実行は旧算術平均源のまま105条件中2条件で不合格（最細衝撃位置3.923セル、plateau密度誤差11.03%）となり、全結果を保存しました。第2試行は球の面応力求積だけを変更しましたが、同じ2条件が未達（衝撃位置3.919セル、密度誤差11.018%）でした。第3試行はその求積を保ち、球だけMUSCL・minmod再構築を加えて、同じ105条件で比較します。 第3試行は28検査と全12格子計算を完了し、105条件すべてに合格しました。球N=512では全域密度L1=.0114343、衝撃位置誤差1.98856セル、plateau密度誤差5.2533%、原点込みcore密度L1=.0549503です。一方、中心最大比内部エネルギーの相対過剰は20.59%で、第2試行の15.52%より悪化しており、全指標の改善は主張しません。
note.en: Retain the planar/cylindrical acceptance file and all 59 original decisions, and save spherical criteria, inputs and source hashes before the first spherical PDE run. The initial cylindrical failure retains its source, all eight diagnostic logs and failed summary; the face-stress revision was tested against the same gates. Analytic conserved means split shock-crossing integrals and distinguish p(mean U) from mean p. The pinned independent LANL ExactPack analytic comparison includes d=1/2/3. New spherical PDE refinements separately measure full-domain r^2-weighted L1/L2/Linf, density L1 in r<=.70rs including the origin, and center/shock/plateau diagnostics. Discrete stage-weighted inflow budgets are distinct from continuous analytic totals; SSPRK2 boundary quadrature is checked through M_h-M_exact=sum(dt^3)/6 and E_h-E_exact=sum(dt^3)/12. The first spherical run retained arithmetic source quadrature and failed two of 105 gates (finest shock-position error 3.923 cells, plateau-density error 11.03%); all results are retained. A second attempt changed only spherical stress quadrature, but still failed the same two gates (3.919 cells and 11.018% density error). A third attempt retains that quadrature and adds MUSCL/minmod reconstruction only for spherical runs, against the same 105 criteria. The third attempt completed 28 tests and all 12 grid runs, passing all 105 gates. note.ja: 半解析解 理想気体Eulerの球半径対称、γ=5/3、周囲密度1・圧力0、爆発エネルギー1、r∈[0,1]、t=0.05。自己相似参照は瞬間的な理想点源を表しますが、有限体積計算は半径0.03の内部へ投入し、同じ最細格子で半径0.015も比較します。参照は相似ODEの数値積分、小さな中心域の正則漸近形、衝撃位置で分割する球殻求積を含む半解析解であり、閉形式の厳密セル平均ではありません。ギャラリー図は1次元球半径データの中心断面で、2D Cartesian計算ではありません。固定投入半径での誤差には点源とのモデル差が含まれ、その傾きは純粋な空間収束次数ではなく、投入半径の変更も感度診断に留まります。 エネルギー正規化した球対称の自己相似参照。相似ODEの数値積分・球殻平均の求積を含む半解析解で、閉形式の厳密セル平均とは区別します。有限半径の投入初期値は理想点爆発の特異初期値と一致しません。 固定した有限の投入半径で点源の自己相似参照と比べるため、誤差曲線には投入モデルの差も含まれ、純粋な空間精度の収束次数ではありません。同じ最細格子で投入半径を変える比較は感度診断であり、連続極限の投入誤差とPDE離散化誤差を完全に分離する検証ではありません。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference Ideal-gas Euler in spherical radial symmetry, gamma=5/3, ambient rho0=1 and p0=0, explosion energy E0=1, r in [0,1], t=0.05. The similarity reference describes ideal instantaneous point deposition. Finite-volume runs instead deposit energy inside radius 0.03, with a paired radius-0.015 sensitivity calculation. The reference uses a numerical similarity-ODE integration, a tiny-core regular asymptote and split shell quadrature; it is semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. The gallery picture is a central section of one-dimensional spherical-radial data, not a two-dimensional Cartesian computation. Fixed-radius errors include point-source model discrepancy, so their refinement slope is not a pure spatial order; the paired-radius calculation is only a sensitivity diagnostic. An energy-normalized spherical similarity reference. Numerical integration of similarity ODEs and shell quadrature make this semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. Finite-radius deposition is distinct from the singular ideal point-blast initial data. At fixed finite deposition radius, comparison with the point-source similarity reference includes deposition-model discrepancy; its refinement slope is not a pure spatial order. Changing deposition radius on the same finest grid is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a complete separation of continuum deposition and PDE-discretization errors.

note.en: Reference sin(πx)sin(πy) on the unit square; refine CG/MG through 15/31/63 interior nodes and P1 FEM through 4/8/16 subdivisions. Independently evaluate FD maximum errors/true residuals and FEM element-interior L2/H1-seminorm errors.

name.ja: 行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける

note.ja: 正方形Poisson問題から得たSPD行列だけを階層構築へ渡し、平滑化集約AMGのV-cycleを実行します。7²・15²・31²未知数で独立疎行列直接解、解析的な離散正弦モード、連続解への2次収束を分けて検査します。
note.en: Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution.

Compare RK4 with the analytic solution at every output time; check nonnegativity and time refinement. Excludes reaction–diffusion and multispecies models. Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters.

note.ja: 独立NumPy/SciPy参照、行列再構成・直交性・特異値・階数・最小二乗残差を確認します。PDEの参照解カードとは別の線形代数検証です。 別版では条件数、右辺摂動、数値階数の閾値を変え、残差と係数の前進誤差を分けます。LAPACKと実際の二進入力から作る高精度参照の役割を区別し、QR／SVD全般や任意の悪条件行列の保証にはしません。
note.en: Check independent NumPy/SciPy references, reconstruction, orthogonality, singular values, rank and least-squares residuals. This is linear-algebra validation rather than a PDE reference-solution card. A separate release varies conditioning, right-hand-side perturbations and numerical-rank thresholds while separating residual from coefficient forward error. Distinguish LAPACK from high-precision references built from actual binary input; no general QR/SVD or arbitrary ill-conditioned-matrix guarantee is implied.

name.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗

note.en: Original Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD for real tall matrices are checked on ordinary, 10⁶-column-scaled and rank-deficient inputs, against separate LAPACK singular values and minimum-norm least-squares solutions.

note.en: Vary condition number from 1 to 2³⁶ for exactly representable 16×4 dyadic matrices, separating reconstruction from forward solution error. Compare LAPACK and separately executed 80/120-digit references for the actual binary64 inputs.

note.en: Construct Gaussian nodes/weights from the Legendre recurrence and test polynomial moments through degree 2n−1 and an exponential. Adaptive Simpson integrates exponential and Lorentzian peaks, against analytic integrals and independent QUADPACK.

note.en: Vary Gauss order and adaptive tolerance on narrow Lorentz peaks, a square-root endpoint, severe cancellation, a zero integral and a deliberately missed compact bump, using analytic integrals and QUADPACK.

Changing deposition radius on the same finest grid is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a complete separation of continuum deposition and PDE-discretization errors.

note.ja: 旧平面・円筒の受入基準と59判定を保持し、球の追加基準・入力・ソースhashを初回の球PDE実行前に保存します。初回の円筒不合格はソース・全8本の診断ログ・不合格サマリーを保持し、同じ基準で面応力版を再検証した履歴です。厳密保存量セル平均は衝撃をまたぐ積分を分割し、p(平均U)と平均pを分けます。固定版LANL ExactPackの独立解析照合はd=1/2/3を含みます。球の新規PDE系列では全域r²重みL1/L2/L∞、原点を含むr≤.70rsの密度L1、原点・衝撃・plateauを別測定。各段の境界流入による離散保存収支と、連続解析総量との差を分け、M_h−M_exact=Σdt³/6、E_h−E_exact=Σdt³/12というSSPRK2境界求積の恒等式を検査します。 最初の球対称実行は旧算術平均源のまま105条件中2条件で不合格（最細衝撃位置3.923セル、plateau密度誤差11.03%）となり、全結果を保存しました。第2試行は球の面応力求積だけを変更しましたが、同じ2条件が未達（衝撃位置3.919セル、密度誤差11.018%）でした。第3試行はその求積を保ち、球だけMUSCL・minmod再構築を加えて、同じ105条件で比較します。 第3試行は28検査と全12格子計算を完了し、105条件すべてに合格しました。球N=512では全域密度L1=.0114343、衝撃位置誤差1.98856セル、plateau密度誤差5.2533%、原点込みcore密度L1=.0549503です。一方、中心最大比内部エネルギーの相対過剰は20.59%で、第2試行の15.52%より悪化しており、全指標の改善は主張しません。
note.en: Retain the planar/cylindrical acceptance file and all 59 original decisions, and save spherical criteria, inputs and source hashes before the first spherical PDE run. The initial cylindrical failure retains its source, all eight diagnostic logs and failed summary; the face-stress revision was tested against the same gates. Analytic conserved means split shock-crossing integrals and distinguish p(mean U) from mean p. The pinned independent LANL ExactPack analytic comparison includes d=1/2/3. New spherical PDE refinements separately measure full-domain r^2-weighted L1/L2/Linf, density L1 in r<=.70rs including the origin, and center/shock/plateau diagnostics. Discrete stage-weighted inflow budgets are distinct from continuous analytic totals; SSPRK2 boundary quadrature is checked through M_h-M_exact=sum(dt^3)/6 and E_h-E_exact=sum(dt^3)/12. The first spherical run retained arithmetic source quadrature and failed two of 105 gates (finest shock-position error 3.923 cells, plateau-density error 11.03%); all results are retained. A second attempt changed only spherical stress quadrature, but still failed the same two gates (3.919 cells and 11.018% density error). A third attempt retains that quadrature and adds MUSCL/minmod reconstruction only for spherical runs, against the same 105 criteria. The third attempt completed 28 tests and all 12 grid runs, passing all 105 gates. At spherical N=512 the whole-domain density L1 is .0114343, shock error 1.98856 cells, plateau-density error 5.2533%, and origin-inclusive core-density L1 .0549503. Maximum center specific-internal-energy excess is 20.59%, worse than the second attempt's 15.52%; not every diagnostic improves.

name.ja: Nohの冷たい流入衝撃波：平面・円筒・球対称
name.en: Noh cold-inflow shock: planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry

note.ja: 解析解 理想気体Euler、γ=5/3、初期密度1・内向き速度1・圧力0。r∈[0,1]、t=0.6。平面(d=1)・円筒半径対称(d=2)・球半径対称(d=3)の有限体積計算で、圧力の床は使いません。球のカラー図は1次元半径データの中心断面で、Cartesianの3次元計算ではありません。 別の実2D Cartesian版では[-.5,.5]²の32²/64²/128²格子、2成分運動量と両方向流束を使い、半径還元は行いません。密度参照は衝撃円で分割した64/128点の求積セル平均です。 同じNoh問題の解析参照。1Dは保存量の厳密体積平均、2Dは衝撃円で分割した密度の求積セル平均を使用します。点値とセル平均、p(平均U)と平均pを区別します。
note.en: Analytic reference Ideal-gas Euler, gamma=5/3, rho0=1, inward speed 1, p0=0; r in [0,1], t=0.6. Planar (d=1), cylindrical-radial (d=2) and spherical-radial (d=3) finite-volume calculations without a pressure floor. The spherical color picture is a central section of one-dimensional radial data, not a Cartesian three-dimensional computation. A separate full-square2D Cartesian calculation uses [-.5,.5]^2 with32²/64²/128² cells, both momenta and no radial reduction. Its density-cell reference is shock-split quadrature, checked at orders64/128. Analytic reference for the same Noh problem.1D uses exact conserved-volume means;2D uses density means from shock-split Cartesian cell quadrature. Distinguish points/cell means and p(mean U)/mean p.

name.ja: Sedov–Taylorの点爆発：エネルギー正規化した球対称自己相似解
name.en: Sedov–Taylor point blast: energy-normalized spherical similarity solution

note.ja: 半解析解 理想気体Eulerの球半径対称、γ=5/3、周囲密度1・圧力0、爆発エネルギー1、r∈[0,1]、t=0.05。自己相似参照は瞬間的な理想点源を表しますが、有限体積計算は半径0.03の内部へ投入し、同じ最細格子で半径0.015も比較します。参照は相似ODEの数値積分、小さな中心域の正則漸近形、衝撃位置で分割する球殻求積を含む半解析解であり、閉形式の厳密セル平均ではありません。ギャラリー図は1次元球半径データの中心断面で、2D Cartesian計算ではありません。固定投入半径での誤差には点源とのモデル差が含まれ、その傾きは純粋な空間収束次数ではなく、投入半径の変更も感度診断に留まります。 エネルギー正規化した球対称の自己相似参照。相似ODEの数値積分・球殻平均の求積を含む半解析解で、閉形式の厳密セル平均とは区別します。有限半径の投入初期値は理想点爆発の特異初期値と一致しません。 固定した有限の投入半径で点源の自己相似参照と比べるため、誤差曲線には投入モデルの差も含まれ、純粋な空間精度の収束次数ではありません。同じ最細格子で投入半径を変える比較は感度診断であり、連続極限の投入誤差とPDE離散化誤差を完全に分離する検証ではありません。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference Ideal-gas Euler in spherical radial symmetry, gamma=5/3, ambient rho0=1 and p0=0, explosion energy E0=1, r in [0,1], t=0.05. The similarity reference describes ideal instantaneous point deposition. Finite-volume runs instead deposit energy inside radius 0.03, with a paired radius-0.015 sensitivity calculation. The reference uses a numerical similarity-ODE integration, a tiny-core regular asymptote and split shell quadrature; it is semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. The gallery picture is a central section of one-dimensional spherical-radial data, not a two-dimensional Cartesian computation. Fixed-radius errors include point-source model discrepancy, so their refinement slope is not a pure spatial order; the paired-radius calculation is only a sensitivity diagnostic. An energy-normalized spherical similarity reference. Numerical integration of similarity ODEs and shell quadrature make this semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. Finite-radius deposition is distinct from the singular ideal point-blast initial data. At fixed finite deposition radius, comparison with the point-source similarity reference includes deposition-model discrepancy; its refinement slope is not a pure spatial order. Changing deposition radius on the same finest grid is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a complete separation of continuum deposition and PDE-discretization errors.

caption.ja: 実際の2次元Cartesian Euler計算の密度場。正方形全域128²セル、初期圧力ゼロ、γ=5/3、t=.6。白破線は厳密衝撃円。軸・対角方向の差と原点過熱を残し、1D半径例にも辿れます。
caption.en: Density from an actual2D Cartesian Euler computation:full square128²,p0=0,gamma5/3,t=.6. White dashed circle is the exact shock. Axis/diagonal differences and origin heating remain visible, with links to earlier1D radial examples.

note.ja: RusanovとHeunは1D半径例と新2D Cartesian例で使用。MUSCL/minmodは旧球対称系列に限定され、新2D版は区分定数です。
note.en: Rusanov/Heun are used in both radial1D and new Cartesian2D runs. MUSCL/minmod apply only to the earlier spherical series; the new2D reconstruction is piecewise constant.

name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 旧平面・円筒の受入基準と59判定を保持し、球の追加基準・入力・ソースhashを初回の球PDE実行前に保存します。初回の円筒不合格はソース・全8本の診断ログ・不合格サマリーを保持し、同じ基準で面応力版を再検証した履歴です。厳密保存量セル平均は衝撃をまたぐ積分を分割し、p(平均U)と平均pを分けます。固定版LANL ExactPackの独立解析照合はd=1/2/3を含みます。球の新規PDE系列では全域r²重みL1/L2/L∞、原点を含むr≤.70rsの密度L1、原点・衝撃・plateauを別測定。各段の境界流入による離散保存収支と、連続解析総量との差を分け、M_h−M_exact=Σdt³/6、E_h−E_exact=Σdt³/12というSSPRK2境界求積の恒等式を検査します。 最初の球対称実行は旧算術平均源のまま105条件中2条件で不合格（最細衝撃位置3.923セル、plateau密度誤差11.03%）となり、全結果を保存しました。第2試行は球の面応力求積だけを変更しましたが、同じ2条件が未達（衝撃位置3.919セル、密度誤差11.018%）でした。第3試行はその求積を保ち、球だけMUSCL・minmod再構築を加えて、同じ105条件で比較します。 第3試行は28検査と全12格子計算を完了し、105条件すべてに合格しました。球N=512では全域密度L1=.0114343、衝撃位置誤差1.98856セル、plateau密度誤差5.2533%、原点込みcore密度L1=.0549503です。一方、中心最大比内部エネルギーの相対過剰は20.59%で、第2試行の15.52%より悪化しており、全指標の改善は主張しません。
note.en: Retain the planar/cylindrical acceptance file and all 59 original decisions, and save spherical criteria, inputs and source hashes before the first spherical PDE run. The initial cylindrical failure retains its source, all eight diagnostic logs and failed summary; the face-stress revision was tested against the same gates. Analytic conserved means split shock-crossing integrals and distinguish p(mean U) from mean p. The pinned independent LANL ExactPack analytic comparison includes d=1/2/3. New spherical PDE refinements separately measure full-domain r^2-weighted L1/L2/Linf, density L1 in r<=.70rs including the origin, and center/shock/plateau diagnostics. Discrete stage-weighted inflow budgets are distinct from continuous analytic totals; SSPRK2 boundary quadrature is checked through M_h-M_exact=sum(dt^3)/6 and E_h-E_exact=sum(dt^3)/12. The first spherical run retained arithmetic source quadrature and failed two of 105 gates (finest shock-position error 3.923 cells, plateau-density error 11.03%); all results are retained. A second attempt changed only spherical stress quadrature, but still failed the same two gates (3.919 cells and 11.018% density error). A third attempt retains that quadrature and adds MUSCL/minmod reconstruction only for spherical runs, against the same 105 criteria. The third attempt completed 28 tests and all 12 grid runs, passing all 105 gates. At spherical N=512 the whole-domain density L1 is .0114343, shock error 1.98856 cells, plateau-density error 5.2533%, and origin-inclusive core-density L1 .0549503. Maximum center specific-internal-energy excess is 20.59%, worse than the second attempt's 15.52%; not every diagnostic improves.

name.ja: Nohの冷たい流入衝撃波：平面・円筒・球対称
name.en: Noh cold-inflow shock: planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry

note.ja: 解析解 理想気体Euler、γ=5/3、初期密度1・内向き速度1・圧力0。r∈[0,1]、t=0.6。平面(d=1)・円筒半径対称(d=2)・球半径対称(d=3)の有限体積計算で、圧力の床は使いません。球のカラー図は1次元半径データの中心断面で、Cartesianの3次元計算ではありません。 別の実2D Cartesian版では[-.5,.5]²の32²/64²/128²格子、2成分運動量と両方向流束を使い、半径還元は行いません。密度参照は衝撃円で分割した64/128点の求積セル平均です。 同じNoh問題の解析参照。1Dは保存量の厳密体積平均、2Dは衝撃円で分割した密度の求積セル平均を使用します。点値とセル平均、p(平均U)と平均pを区別します。
note.en: Analytic reference Ideal-gas Euler, gamma=5/3, rho0=1, inward speed 1, p0=0; r in [0,1], t=0.6. Planar (d=1), cylindrical-radial (d=2) and spherical-radial (d=3) finite-volume calculations without a pressure floor. The spherical color picture is a central section of one-dimensional radial data, not a Cartesian three-dimensional computation. A separate full-square2D Cartesian calculation uses [-.5,.5]^2 with32²/64²/128² cells, both momenta and no radial reduction. Its density-cell reference is shock-split quadrature, checked at orders64/128. Analytic reference for the same Noh problem.1D uses exact conserved-volume means;2D uses density means from shock-split Cartesian cell quadrature. Distinguish points/cell means and p(mean U)/mean p.

name.ja: Noh衝撃波：初期圧力ゼロの平面・円筒・球対称計算
name.en: Noh shocks: zero-pressure planar, cylindrical and spherical flow

note.ja: 初期圧力ゼロのNoh問題を、独自の小型1D有限体積コードで平面・円筒・球対称に計算します。64/128/256/512格子の全域誤差、原点過熱、衝撃位置、保存収支を測り、球で現れる境界流入の時間積分誤差を解析式と照合します。
note.en: An original small 1D finite-volume code solves zero-pressure Noh flow in planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry. Grids 64/128/256/512 measure full-domain error, origin heating, shock location and budgets, and compare spherical boundary-inflow time-quadrature error with its analytic identity.

name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 旧平面・円筒の受入基準と59判定を保持し、球の追加基準・入力・ソースhashを初回の球PDE実行前に保存します。初回の円筒不合格はソース・全8本の診断ログ・不合格サマリーを保持し、同じ基準で面応力版を再検証した履歴です。厳密保存量セル平均は衝撃をまたぐ積分を分割し、p(平均U)と平均pを分けます。固定版LANL ExactPackの独立解析照合はd=1/2/3を含みます。球の新規PDE系列では全域r²重みL1/L2/L∞、原点を含むr≤.70rsの密度L1、原点・衝撃・plateauを別測定。各段の境界流入による離散保存収支と、連続解析総量との差を分け、M_h−M_exact=Σdt³/6、E_h−E_exact=Σdt³/12というSSPRK2境界求積の恒等式を検査します。 最初の球対称実行は旧算術平均源のまま105条件中2条件で不合格（最細衝撃位置3.923セル、plateau密度誤差11.03%）となり、全結果を保存しました。第2試行は球の面応力求積だけを変更しましたが、同じ2条件が未達（衝撃位置3.919セル、密度誤差11.018%）でした。第3試行はその求積を保ち、球だけMUSCL・minmod再構築を加えて、同じ105条件で比較します。 第3試行は28検査と全12格子計算を完了し、105条件すべてに合格しました。球N=512では全域密度L1=.0114343、衝撃位置誤差1.98856セル、plateau密度誤差5.2533%、原点込みcore密度L1=.0549503です。一方、中心最大比内部エネルギーの相対過剰は20.59%で、第2試行の15.52%より悪化しており、全指標の改善は主張しません。
note.en: Retain the planar/cylindrical acceptance file and all 59 original decisions, and save spherical criteria, inputs and source hashes before the first spherical PDE run. The initial cylindrical failure retains its source, all eight diagnostic logs and failed summary; the face-stress revision was tested against the same gates. Analytic conserved means split shock-crossing integrals and distinguish p(mean U) from mean p. The pinned independent LANL ExactPack analytic comparison includes d=1/2/3. New spherical PDE refinements separately measure full-domain r^2-weighted L1/L2/Linf, density L1 in r<=.70rs including the origin, and center/shock/plateau diagnostics. Discrete stage-weighted inflow budgets are distinct from continuous analytic totals; SSPRK2 boundary quadrature is checked through M_h-M_exact=sum(dt^3)/6 and E_h-E_exact=sum(dt^3)/12. The first spherical run retained arithmetic source quadrature and failed two of 105 gates (finest shock-position error 3.923 cells, plateau-density error 11.03%); all results are retained. A second attempt changed only spherical stress quadrature, but still failed the same two gates (3.919 cells and 11.018% density error). A third attempt retains that quadrature and adds MUSCL/minmod reconstruction only for spherical runs, against the same 105 criteria. The third attempt completed 28 tests and all 12 grid runs, passing all 105 gates. At spherical N=512 the whole-domain density L1 is .0114343, shock error 1.98856 cells, plateau-density error 5.2533%, and origin-inclusive core-density L1 .0549503. Maximum center specific-internal-energy excess is 20.59%, worse than the second attempt's 15.52%; not every diagnostic improves.

name.ja: Nohの冷たい流入衝撃波：平面・円筒・球対称
name.en: Noh cold-inflow shock: planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry

note.ja: 解析解 理想気体Euler、γ=5/3、初期密度1・内向き速度1・圧力0。r∈[0,1]、t=0.6。平面(d=1)・円筒半径対称(d=2)・球半径対称(d=3)の有限体積計算で、圧力の床は使いません。球のカラー図は1次元半径データの中心断面で、Cartesianの3次元計算ではありません。 別の実2D Cartesian版では[-.5,.5]²の32²/64²/128²格子、2成分運動量と両方向流束を使い、半径還元は行いません。密度参照は衝撃円で分割した64/128点の求積セル平均です。 同じNoh問題の解析参照。1Dは保存量の厳密体積平均、2Dは衝撃円で分割した密度の求積セル平均を使用します。点値とセル平均、p(平均U)と平均pを区別します。
note.en: Analytic reference Ideal-gas Euler, gamma=5/3, rho0=1, inward speed 1, p0=0; r in [0,1], t=0.6. Planar (d=1), cylindrical-radial (d=2) and spherical-radial (d=3) finite-volume calculations without a pressure floor. The spherical color picture is a central section of one-dimensional radial data, not a Cartesian three-dimensional computation. A separate full-square2D Cartesian calculation uses [-.5,.5]^2 with32²/64²/128² cells, both momenta and no radial reduction. Its density-cell reference is shock-split quadrature, checked at orders64/128. Analytic reference for the same Noh problem.1D uses exact conserved-volume means;2D uses density means from shock-split Cartesian cell quadrature. Distinguish points/cell means and p(mean U)/mean p.

note.en: Inputs, numerical sources, acceptance and22 tests were hash-locked before the first FV execution. All22 unit tests and48 gates on four calculations passed on the first attempt. The independent reference integrates the similarity ODE with DOP853, normalizes energy, uses a regular asymptote for xi<.001 and split shell quadrature at the shock. Orders16/32, core cutoff and ODE tolerance are checked separately. The unmodified pinned ExactPack evaluator was independently run at6001/12001 points and compared away from the center/jump with its preregistered5e-4 criterion. Beta=1.15166641793, Rs(.05)=.34746791233. Origin/shock-inclusive volume-weighted density L1 within r<=1.2Rs is.17257/.12785/.07458 and pressure L1 is.18148/.13939/.07615. Finest shock error is1.096 cells; maximum relative discrete-budget residual is about1.34e-15.

name.ja: Sedov–Taylorの点爆発：エネルギー正規化した球対称自己相似解
name.en: Sedov–Taylor point blast: energy-normalized spherical similarity solution

note.ja: 半解析解 理想気体Eulerの球半径対称、γ=5/3、周囲密度1・圧力0、爆発エネルギー1、r∈[0,1]、t=0.05。自己相似参照は瞬間的な理想点源を表しますが、有限体積計算は半径0.03の内部へ投入し、同じ最細格子で半径0.015も比較します。参照は相似ODEの数値積分、小さな中心域の正則漸近形、衝撃位置で分割する球殻求積を含む半解析解であり、閉形式の厳密セル平均ではありません。ギャラリー図は1次元球半径データの中心断面で、2D Cartesian計算ではありません。固定投入半径での誤差には点源とのモデル差が含まれ、その傾きは純粋な空間収束次数ではなく、投入半径の変更も感度診断に留まります。 エネルギー正規化した球対称の自己相似参照。相似ODEの数値積分・球殻平均の求積を含む半解析解で、閉形式の厳密セル平均とは区別します。有限半径の投入初期値は理想点爆発の特異初期値と一致しません。 固定した有限の投入半径で点源の自己相似参照と比べるため、誤差曲線には投入モデルの差も含まれ、純粋な空間精度の収束次数ではありません。同じ最細格子で投入半径を変える比較は感度診断であり、連続極限の投入誤差とPDE離散化誤差を完全に分離する検証ではありません。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference Ideal-gas Euler in spherical radial symmetry, gamma=5/3, ambient rho0=1 and p0=0, explosion energy E0=1, r in [0,1], t=0.05. The similarity reference describes ideal instantaneous point deposition. Finite-volume runs instead deposit energy inside radius 0.03, with a paired radius-0.015 sensitivity calculation. The reference uses a numerical similarity-ODE integration, a tiny-core regular asymptote and split shell quadrature; it is semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. The gallery picture is a central section of one-dimensional spherical-radial data, not a two-dimensional Cartesian computation. Fixed-radius errors include point-source model discrepancy, so their refinement slope is not a pure spatial order; the paired-radius calculation is only a sensitivity diagnostic. An energy-normalized spherical similarity reference. Numerical integration of similarity ODEs and shell quadrature make this semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. Finite-radius deposition is distinct from the singular ideal point-blast initial data. At fixed finite deposition radius, comparison with the point-source similarity reference includes deposition-model discrepancy; its refinement slope is not a pure spatial order. Changing deposition radius on the same finest grid is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a complete separation of continuum deposition and PDE-discretization errors.

name.ja: ロジスティック個体群増殖

note.ja: 収容力Kを持つ密度依存の連続時間増殖モデル。離散ロジスティック写像とは区別します。 限定した実行例：無次元の単一個体群。RK4を全出力時刻で解析解と比較し、非負性と刻み幅の収束を確認。反応拡散・複数種は対象外。
note.en: Density-limited growth with carrying capacity K. It is the simplest biological ODE baseline. The linked original is the later 1847 memoir; the 1838 note itself was not audited. The differential equation is not the discrete logistic map. Scoped executed example: One dimensionless population. Compare RK4 with the analytic solution at every output time; check nonnegativity and time refinement. Excludes reaction–diffusion and multispecies models.

note.ja: 閉じた一様混合集団の規格化SIR系。SEIRは曝露区画を追加します。人数と割合ではβの定義が異なります。 限定した実行例：閉鎖・均質な人口割合SIR。RK4と別実装のSciPy DOP853を比較。人口保存・非負性・時間収束を確認。SEIR・空間伝播・実データ較正は対象外。
note.en: Closed, well-mixed normalized population fractions. SEIR adds an exposed compartment and a progression rate. The original general epidemic framework is broader than this SIR specialization. Population-count and fraction conventions give different β definitions. Scoped executed example: Closed homogeneous population-fraction SIR. Compare RK4 with independently implemented SciPy DOP853; check conservation, nonnegativity and time convergence. Excludes SEIR, spatial spread and calibration to observations.

note.ja: 一定拡散係数νの代表形。モードの減衰、時間積分、境界条件へ。
note.en: A representative constant-diffusivity form: mode decay, time integration and boundaries.

note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

note.ja: 2成分反応拡散の枠組み。f・gは個別に指定する必要があり、模様の画像だけでTuring機構とは判定できません。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。
note.en: A framework for diffusion-driven pattern onset around a homogeneous reaction equilibrium, not a unique choice of f and g. note.ja: CSVは最細格子でx・数値解・解析解・誤差を整列。全3格子の誤差と残差、隣接格子間の次数はresult.jsonに保存。Thomasの原報告は既存台帳でも直接確認未済のため、未検証の一次文献を新たに掲げない。
note.en: CSV aligns finest-grid x, numerical/analytic values and error. JSON retains all three errors/residuals and adjacent-level orders. The Thomas original report remains unverified in the existing catalog, so no newly verified primary-source claim is added.

note.ja: 製造解 両端はゼロDirichlet条件。目標解から外力を選ぶ製造解であり、任意の外力のPoisson解ではありません。 単一sin(πx)の共通固定入力とは一致しますが、保存比較図は複合正弦製造解も含みます。同じ零Dirichletでも全ソースが同一ではありません。
note.en: Manufactured solution Zero Dirichlet endpoints. The forcing is chosen from the target solution; this is not an arbitrary-source Poisson solution. It matches the single-sine common fixed input, but saved comparisons also contain composite-sine manufactured forcing. Zero Dirichlet boundaries do not make all sources identical.

note.en: Fixed one-atom simple-cubic He cell (lattice constant 4 bohr, two valence electrons, unpolarized LDA_X plus VWN5, local GTH). A PySCF execution/validation workflow. note.ja: 正規化残差、SciPy spsolveとの相対解差、連続正弦解への離散L²型誤差、観測次数、operator complexityを保存します。節点順を無作為に置き換えた行列も直接解と照合し、幾何学的な粗格子を暗黙に使っていないことを確認します。反復予算0は未収束と報告します。
note.en: Store normalized residuals, relative solution differences against SciPy spsolve, discrete-L²-type continuum errors, observed order and operator complexity. A randomly permuted matrix is also checked against a direct solution to expose hidden geometric ordering assumptions. A zero cycle budget reports nonconvergence.

note.ja: 製造解 両端はゼロDirichlet条件。目標解から外力を選ぶ製造解であり、任意の外力のPoisson解ではありません。 カードは1次元sin(πx)、こちらは2次元sin(πx)sin(πy)です。次元・右辺・FEMの誤差ノルムは異なります。
note.en: Manufactured solution Zero Dirichlet endpoints. The forcing is chosen from the target solution; this is not an arbitrary-source Poisson solution. The card is 1D sin(πx); this test is 2D sin(πx)sin(πy). Dimension, forcing and FEM error norms differ.

name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 再構成・直交性・特異値・右辺摂動による解差・最小二乗停留残差・厳密階数2の対照を保存します。高精度参照は実二進入力を整数比へ変換し、mpmath 1.3.0のSVDとQRを独立実行済みです。SHAと全4入力・両精度の完全性を実行時に検査し、不一致を解析解へ置換しません。
note.en: Save reconstruction, orthogonality, singular values, solution perturbations, least-squares stationarity and an exact rank-two control. The mpmath1.3.0 SVD and QR reference was actually executed using integer-ratio conversions of binary inputs. note.ja: 参照は同じFD半離散系を実空間の疎行列・別記述の反応RHSで組み、分割せずRadauで積分した数値解です。Radauの公差細分化と別のDOP853で参照自身の差を測り、最細Strang誤差との比を判定します。ノルムは成分ごとの平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を求めて悪い成分を採用し、4つの正の共通出力時刻の最大値で次数を測定。Newton公差感度、全副段階の正濃度、反応source/sink収支と逆順Lieの対照も記録します。
note.en: The reference independently assembles the SAME FD semidiscretization with a real-space sparse matrix and separately written reaction RHS, then integrates it unsplit with Radau. Tighter Radau and separate DOP853 runs measure reference sensitivity relative to the finest Strang error. Norms are per-species mean L1, RMS L2 and maximum L∞, then the worse species; refinement uses the maximum across the four common positive observation times. Also record Newton-tolerance sensitivity, positive tested substeps, reaction source/sink balance and reversed-Lie ordering.

note.ja: 重力Poisson方程式の孤立境界に対応する密度場の畳み込み問題です。粒子の軟化二体力や全方向周期Poissonの例とは区別し、この図ではゼロ埋めFFTと同じ離散核の非周期直接畳み込みを照合します。 同じ離散核・セル体積・自己項を使う非周期直接畳み込みと、ゼロ埋めFFTの一致を確認します。連続核の離散化誤差とは別です。
note.en: A density-field convolution for the gravitational Poisson equation with isolated boundaries, distinct from softened particle-pair forces or fully periodic Poisson examples. This visual compares zero-padded FFT with nonperiodic direct convolution using the same discrete kernel. Check zero-padded FFT against nonperiodic direct convolution using the same discrete kernel, cell volumes and self term. This is separate from continuum-kernel discretization error.

note.ja: 水平周期・鉛直孤立の重力Poisson問題で、一様平板の零水平モードを扱います。下のPoisson代表式に対し、ここでの右辺は4πGρです。全方向周期境界や軟化粒子系とは区別します。 一様平板のφ=2πz²を定数ゲージ調整後に比較し、加速度-4πzと零水平モードを確認します。
note.en: A gravitational Poisson problem periodic horizontally and isolated vertically, using the zero horizontal mode of a uniform slab. The right-hand side of the representative Poisson equation below is 4πGρ here; fully periodic boundaries and softened particle systems are different cases. Compare with φ=2πz² after aligning the additive gauge; check acceleration -4πz and the zero horizontal mode.

note.ja: 水平周期・鉛直孤立の重力Poisson問題で、面密度の非零水平モードと零モードを扱います。Poisson代表式の右辺は4πGρです。全方向周期場や軟化粒子の二体力とは区別します。 正弦状面密度の指数減衰核と一様面の絶対値核を足した解析式で、水平周期・鉛直孤立の場を確認します。
note.en: A gravitational Poisson problem periodic horizontally and isolated vertically, combining nonzero and zero horizontal modes of a sheet density. The Poisson right-hand side is 4πGρ; this differs from fully periodic fields or softened particle-pair forces. Check the horizontally periodic, vertically isolated field using the analytic exponential kernel for sinusoidal sheet density plus the absolute-value kernel for its uniform part.

note.ja: リンクは静電Poisson/Laplace場です。中性周期Coulomb電荷のEwald/PME問題であり、重力の質量・符号・境界を流用しません。 同じ中性周期電荷・規約の収束したEwald和、力の有限差分とカットオフ・格子収束を確認します。孤立重力粒子の直接和とは境界・相互作用が異なります。 追加版は同じ中性8点電荷・立方体・tin-foil規約のエネルギーと全粒子力を、別実装theta積分と参照自身の細分化に照合します。SPMEはB-splineのエネルギー勾配型であり、原Lagrange PMEや厳密運動量保存を主張しません。
note.en: The link is the electrostatic Poisson/Laplace field. This is neutral periodic Coulomb Ewald/PME, not an interchange of gravitational masses, signs or boundaries. Check converged Ewald sums for identical neutral periodic charges/conventions, force finite differences and cutoff/mesh refinement. Boundaries and interactions differ from isolated gravitational direct sums. The companion compares energy and every force for the same neutral eight-charge cubic tin-foil cell against a separately implemented theta integral and its own refinement. SPME uses B-spline energy gradients; original Lagrange PME and exact momentum conservation are not claimed.

note.ja: 2次元Poisson/Laplaceの対数Green核を用いる粒子和です。3次元軟化重力1/rモデルとは区別します。 同じ2次元対数核と粒子配置の直接和を数値基準に、多重極の次数・階層変換・力誤差を確認します。3次元1/r核の基準は流用しません。 追加版ではCartesian直接和と解析配置を別の基準にし、展開次数と木深さを分離します。深さに対する単調収束や3次元Coulomb核の精度・計算量を保証しません。
note.en: A particle sum with the logarithmic Green kernel of 2D Poisson/Laplace, distinct from softened 3D 1/r gravity. Use direct summation with the same 2D logarithmic kernel and particles to check expansion order, hierarchical translations and force error. Do not reuse a 3D 1/r reference. The companion uses Cartesian direct sums and analytic configurations as separate references, varying expansion order and tree depth independently. It guarantees neither monotonic error with depth nor accuracy/complexity for a 3D Coulomb kernel.

note.ja: Poissonへのリンクは自己無撞着な静電場の部分です。粒子の運動・CIC補間を結合したPIC全体の式が一覧に揃っているわけではありません。 小振幅の冷たいプラズマの線形変位cos(t)と比較し、電荷整合性・Poisson残差・自己力、格子系列と時間刻み系列を確認します。一般の非線形PIC軌道の厳密解という主張ではありません。 追加版は静止イオン背景のまま、電荷・運動量・粒子と場のエネルギーを軌道誤差と分けます。小振幅線形参照であり、熱的Landau減衰や電磁PICの根拠ではありません。
note.en: Poisson identifies the self-consistent electrostatic field; the registry does not list the complete coupled particle-motion/CIC PIC system. Compare with linear cold-plasma displacement cos(t); check charge compatibility, Poisson residual, self force, and separate grid/timestep series. This is not an exact reference for general nonlinear PIC trajectories. The companion retains stationary background ions and separates charge, momentum and particle/field-energy diagnostics from trajectory error. Its reference is small-amplitude linear theory, supplying no evidence for thermal Landau damping or electromagnetic PIC.

note.en: Nondimensional spherical-radial Euler flow, evolving radial density, momentum and total energy with volume weighting. An energy-normalized spherical similarity reference. Numerical integration of similarity ODEs and shell quadrature make this semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. Finite-radius deposition is distinct from the singular ideal point-blast initial data. At fixed finite deposition radius, comparison with the point-source similarity reference includes deposition-model discrepancy; its refinement slope is not a pure spatial order. Changing deposition radius on the same finest grid is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a complete separation of continuum deposition and PDE-discretization errors.

note.en: Nondimensional spherical-radial Euler flow, evolving radial density, momentum and total energy with volume weighting. Semi-analytic reference Ideal-gas Euler in spherical radial symmetry, gamma=5/3, ambient rho0=1 and p0=0, explosion energy E0=1, r in [0,1], t=0.05. The similarity reference describes ideal instantaneous point deposition. Finite-volume runs instead deposit energy inside radius 0.03, with a paired radius-0.015 sensitivity calculation. The reference uses a numerical similarity-ODE integration, a tiny-core regular asymptote and split shell quadrature; it is semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. The gallery picture is a central section of one-dimensional spherical-radial data, not a two-dimensional Cartesian computation. Fixed-radius errors include point-source model discrepancy, so their refinement slope is not a pure spatial order; the paired-radius calculation is only a sensitivity diagnostic. An energy-normalized spherical similarity reference. Numerical integration of similarity ODEs and shell quadrature make this semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. Finite-radius deposition is distinct from the singular ideal point-blast initial data. At fixed finite deposition radius, comparison with the point-source similarity reference includes deposition-model discrepancy; its refinement slope is not a pure spatial order. Changing deposition radius on the same finest grid is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a complete separation of continuum deposition and PDE-discretization errors.

name.ja: Noh衝撃波：初期圧力ゼロの平面・円筒・球対称計算
name.en: Noh shocks: zero-pressure planar, cylindrical and spherical flow

note.ja: 1D平面・円筒・球の半径対称Euler系と、実際の2D Cartesian Euler系。2D版には幾何源・半径還元・対称境界がなく、全4辺の冷たい流入を与えます。 初期圧力ゼロのNoh問題を、独自の小型1D有限体積コードで平面・円筒・球対称に計算します。64/128/256/512格子の全域誤差、原点過熱、衝撃位置、保存収支を測り、球で現れる境界流入の時間積分誤差を解析式と照合します。
note.en: Planar/cylindrical/spherical radial Euler and actual2D Cartesian Euler. The2D edition has no geometric source, radial reduction or symmetry boundary; all four edges prescribe cold inflow. An original small 1D finite-volume code solves zero-pressure Noh flow in planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry. Grids 64/128/256/512 measure full-domain error, origin heating, shock location and budgets, and compare spherical boundary-inflow time-quadrature error with its analytic identity.

name.ja: Noh問題：実際の2次元Cartesian Euler計算
name.en: Noh problem: an actual 2D Cartesian Euler calculation

note.ja: 1D平面・円筒・球の半径対称Euler系と、実際の2D Cartesian Euler系。2D版には幾何源・半径還元・対称境界がなく、全4辺の冷たい流入を与えます。 正方形の全域で密度・2成分運動量・全エネルギーを更新する、小型の2次元Euler有限体積計算です。32²・64²・128²の3格子で厳密Noh状態からの誤差・保存収支・格子方向の影響を測ります。図は実際の2次元保存配列で、1D半径解の回転表示ではありません。
note.en: Planar/cylindrical/spherical radial Euler and actual2D Cartesian Euler. The2D edition has no geometric source, radial reduction or symmetry boundary; all four edges prescribe cold inflow. A small 2D Euler finite-volume calculation evolves density, both momenta and total energy over the full square. Three grids,32²/64²/128², measure Noh-reference errors, budgets and grid orientation effects. The picture shows the actual evolved 2D array.

name.ja: Sedov–Taylor点爆発：球対称の軽量検証
name.en: Sedov–Taylor point blast: lightweight spherical-radial validation

note.ja: 無次元の球半径対称Euler系。1D半径方向の密度・運動量・全エネルギーを体積重み付きで発展させます。 球対称Euler方程式を半径方向の有限体積法で解く軽量例です。固定した半径0.03の領域に総エネルギー1を与え、128・256・512セルで点爆発の相似参照からの差と保存収支を測ります。図は1次元球対称データの断面表示で、2次元Cartesian計算ではありません。
note.en: Nondimensional spherical-radial Euler flow, evolving radial density, momentum and total energy with volume weighting. A lightweight spherical-radial Euler finite-volume example deposits unit energy inside fixed radius0.03. Three grids of128/256/512 radial cells measure differences from a point-blast similarity reference and conservation budgets. The picture is a section display of1D spherical data, not a2D Cartesian calculation.

note.ja: 周期単位正方形・γ=5/3・μ0=1の平面理想MHDを扱います。構成した磁気静力学平衡を一定速度で移流する厳密解で、外力による製造解や標準円偏光Alfvén波とは異なります。GLMの補助方程式と具体的な保存変数セル平均は、実行例の式・入力・コードを参照してください。 この問題に明示的に対応するct-glm-smooth-convergence配布例のCTとGLMです。同じLLF係数と時間刻みを使っても、磁場配置・角電場平均・法線場の扱いが異なる離散系全体の比較です。この発散ゼロの物理例を、別の非物理制約対照で測った能動的なcleaning性能と同一視しません。
note.en: Planar ideal MHD on a periodic unit square with gamma=5/3 and mu0=1. The exact solution translates a constructed magnetostatic equilibrium at constant velocity; it is neither a forced manufactured solution nor the standard circularly polarized Alfvén wave. The execution example supplies the GLM auxiliary equation and explicit conserved cell averages. CT and GLM are explicitly bound by the ct-glm-smooth-convergence release example. Matching LLF coefficients and time steps still compares whole discretizations with different magnetic placement, corner EMF averaging and normal-field handling. This solenoidal physical example is distinct from active-cleaning measurements in the separate nonphysical constraint control.

note.ja: 周期単位正方形・γ=5/3・μ0=1の平面理想MHDを扱います。構成した磁気静力学平衡を一定速度で移流する厳密解で、外力による製造解や標準円偏光Alfvén波とは異なります。GLMの補助方程式と具体的な保存変数セル平均は、実行例の式・入力・コードを参照してください。 構成厳密解の保存変数セル平均と格子誤差を比較します。固定した空間RHSを独立DOP853時間積分で解いた参照は時間誤差の確認用であり、別の空間ソルバーとは呼びません。18件の既存参照解ライブラリにはこの構成解のカードがないため、別問題の参照カードを流用せず、該当実行例の式・結果・ソースへ案内します。
note.en: Planar ideal MHD on a periodic unit square with gamma=5/3 and mu0=1. The exact solution translates a constructed magnetostatic equilibrium at constant velocity; it is neither a forced manufactured solution nor the standard circularly polarized Alfvén wave. The execution example supplies the GLM auxiliary equation and explicit conserved cell averages. Compare spatial errors against conserved cell averages of the constructed exact solution. Independent DOP853 integration of the same fixed spatial RHS checks temporal error and is not a separate spatial solver. The existing 18-case reference-solution library has no card for this constructed solution, so use the bound example’s equations, results and source rather than borrowing another problem’s reference card.

note.en: Evolve the one-dimensional γ=2 ideal-MHD shock tube with Bx=0.75 to t=0.1. Compare 64/128-cell HLLD/MC/SSPRK2 with a 512-cell numerical reference, recording density, pressure, longitudinal field, balances and fallback counts.

note.en: Planar ideal MHD on a periodic unit square with gamma=5/3 and mu0=1. The exact solution translates a constructed magnetostatic equilibrium at constant velocity; it is neither a forced manufactured solution nor the standard circularly polarized Alfvén wave. The execution example supplies the GLM auxiliary equation and explicit conserved cell averages. Use a constructed exact equilibrium with nonzero magnetic force balanced by a pressure gradient, matching CT/GLM initial cell states, flux speed bound and time-step sequence.

note.ja: 固定した1原子単純立方Heセル（格子定数4 bohr、価電子2、非偏極LDA_X＋VWN5、局所GTH）。PySCFを使う実行・検証ワークフロー。11設定でk点・Gaussian軌道基底・FFT補助格子・SCFを別々に比較し、Γ／2³は独立DFTK平面波参照と照合。平衡He結晶・完全基底・金属・一般物質は未検証。
note.en: Fixed one-atom simple-cubic He cell (lattice constant 4 bohr, two valence electrons, unpolarized LDA_X plus VWN5, local GTH). A PySCF execution/validation workflow. Eleven settings separately compare k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF; Gamma and 2³ are compared with independent DFTK plane waves. Equilibrium helium, complete-basis, metals and general materials remain unvalidated.

note.en: Asymmetric two-He periodic cell with local GTH and LDA exchange plus VWN5. Compare PySCF analytic forces, including Gaussian-basis derivatives, with energy finite differences for all six coordinates and independent DFTK plane waves. Separate force basis, k-point, SCF and FFT refinement. BOMD coverage is a force interface and short step comparison; long NVE, CPMD and general materials remain unvalidated.

Distinguish points/cell means and p(mean U)/mean p. A small 2D Euler finite-volume calculation evolves density, both momenta and total energy over the full square. Three grids,32²/64²/128², measure Noh-reference errors, budgets and grid orientation effects. The picture shows the actual evolved 2D array.

note.ja: 理想気体Eulerの球半径対称、γ=5/3、周囲密度1・圧力0、爆発エネルギー1、r∈[0,1]、t=0.05。自己相似参照は瞬間的な理想点源を表しますが、有限体積計算は半径0.03の内部へ投入し、同じ最細格子で半径0.015も比較します。参照は相似ODEの数値積分、小さな中心域の正則漸近形、衝撃位置で分割する球殻求積を含む半解析解であり、閉形式の厳密セル平均ではありません。ギャラリー図は1次元球半径データの中心断面で、2D Cartesian計算ではありません。固定投入半径での誤差には点源とのモデル差が含まれ、その傾きは純粋な空間収束次数ではなく、投入半径の変更も感度診断に留まります。
note.en: Ideal-gas Euler in spherical radial symmetry, gamma=5/3, ambient rho0=1 and p0=0, explosion energy E0=1, r in [0,1], t=0.05. The similarity reference describes ideal instantaneous point deposition. Finite-volume runs instead deposit energy inside radius 0.03, with a paired radius-0.015 sensitivity calculation. The reference uses a numerical similarity-ODE integration, a tiny-core regular asymptote and split shell quadrature; it is semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. The gallery picture is a central section of one-dimensional spherical-radial data, not a two-dimensional Cartesian computation. Fixed-radius errors include point-source model discrepancy, so their refinement slope is not a pure spatial order; the paired-radius calculation is only a sensitivity diagnostic.

note.ja: エネルギー正規化した球対称の自己相似参照。相似ODEの数値積分・球殻平均の求積を含む半解析解で、閉形式の厳密セル平均とは区別します。有限半径の投入初期値は理想点爆発の特異初期値と一致しません。 固定した有限の投入半径で点源の自己相似参照と比べるため、誤差曲線には投入モデルの差も含まれ、純粋な空間精度の収束次数ではありません。同じ最細格子で投入半径を変える比較は感度診断であり、連続極限の投入誤差とPDE離散化誤差を完全に分離する検証ではありません。 区分定数のRusanov有限体積流束とSSPRK2/Heunを使う限定した球半径例です。
note.en: An energy-normalized spherical similarity reference. Numerical integration of similarity ODEs and shell quadrature make this semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. Finite-radius deposition is distinct from the singular ideal point-blast initial data. At fixed finite deposition radius, comparison with the point-source similarity reference includes deposition-model discrepancy; its refinement slope is not a pure spatial order. Changing deposition radius on the same finest grid is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a complete separation of continuum deposition and PDE-discretization errors. A scoped spherical-radial example using piecewise-constant Rusanov finite-volume fluxes and SSPRK2/Heun.

note.en: Semi-analytic reference Ideal-gas Euler in spherical radial symmetry, gamma=5/3, ambient rho0=1 and p0=0, explosion energy E0=1, r in [0,1], t=0.05. The similarity reference describes ideal instantaneous point deposition. Finite-volume runs instead deposit energy inside radius 0.03, with a paired radius-0.015 sensitivity calculation. The reference uses a numerical similarity-ODE integration, a tiny-core regular asymptote and split shell quadrature; it is semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. The gallery picture is a central section of one-dimensional spherical-radial data, not a two-dimensional Cartesian computation. Fixed-radius errors include point-source model discrepancy, so their refinement slope is not a pure spatial order; the paired-radius calculation is only a sensitivity diagnostic.

name.ja: 周期Fourierモードの熱拡散：参照・比較条件
name.en: Periodic Fourier-mode heat decay — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 周期区間の単一Fourierモードの指数減衰が解析基準です。保存図の振幅0.25・粘性0.02の条件を、別周波数のコード検査と区別します。
note.en: Analytic exponential decay of a periodic Fourier mode is the standard. Distinguish the saved figure's amplitude 0.25 and viscosity 0.02 from code checks using other frequencies.

note.ja: 解析解 単位区間の周期境界、拡散係数0.02。 保存ギャラリーの周期[0,1]、1+0.25sin(2πx)、ν=0.02、最終時刻1が一致します。別周波数のコード検査への一致は意味しません。 物理的な入力は一致しますが、参照カードの点値標本と保存計算の有限体積セル平均・離散格子は別表現です。
note.en: Analytic reference Periodic unit interval; viscosity 0.02. The saved gallery matches periodic [0,1], 1+0.25sin(2πx), ν=0.02 and final time one; this does not assert a match to separate-frequency code checks. Physical inputs match, but the card’s point samples and the saved computation’s finite-volume cell averages/discrete grid are different representations.

name.ja: Dirichlet境界の熱拡散：参照・比較条件
name.en: Heat decay with Dirichlet boundaries — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 零Dirichlet境界でのsin(πx)の指数減衰と格子収束を確認します。周期境界・平均値1の参照解一覧の熱モードとは別条件です。
note.en: Check exponential decay of sin(πx) with zero Dirichlet endpoints and mesh refinement. The library heat mode instead has periodic boundaries and mean one.

note.ja: 解析解 単位区間の周期境界、拡散係数0.02。 こちらは零Dirichlet・sin(πx)、参照カードは周期境界・1+0.25sin(2πx)・ν=0.02です。
note.en: Analytic reference Periodic unit interval; viscosity 0.02. This test has zero Dirichlet endpoints and sin(πx); the card has periodic boundaries, 1+0.25sin(2πx) and ν=0.02.

name.ja: 1次元Poisson・Dirichlet製造解：参照・比較条件
name.en: 1D Poisson / smooth Dirichlet manufactured solutions — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 零Dirichlet境界の製造正弦解、複合正弦の比較例、および離散残差で確認します。単一sin(πx)の参照カードが全ソース条件を表すわけではありません。
note.en: Use manufactured sine solutions, the composite-sine comparison and discrete residuals with zero Dirichlet endpoints. The single sin(πx) reference does not represent every forcing variant.

note.ja: 製造解 両端はゼロDirichlet条件。目標解から外力を選ぶ製造解であり、任意の外力のPoisson解ではありません。 単一sin(πx)の共通固定入力とは一致しますが、保存比較図は複合正弦製造解も含みます。同じ零Dirichletでも全ソースが同一ではありません。
note.en: Manufactured solution Zero Dirichlet endpoints. The forcing is chosen from the target solution; this is not an arbitrary-source Poisson solution. It matches the single-sine common fixed input, but saved comparisons also contain composite-sine manufactured forcing. Zero Dirichlet boundaries do not make all sources identical.

note.en: Check x² with its discrete mean removed for f=-2 and outward derivatives (0,2), together with Neumann compatibility and the mean gauge.

note.ja: 製造解 両端はゼロDirichlet条件。目標解から外力を選ぶ製造解であり、任意の外力のPoisson解ではありません。 参照カードはsin(πx)・零Dirichlet、こちらはf=-2・純Neumann・平均ゲージです。
note.en: Manufactured solution Zero Dirichlet endpoints. The forcing is chosen from the target solution; this is not an arbitrary-source Poisson solution. The card is sin(πx) with zero Dirichlet boundaries; this test uses f=-2, pure Neumann data and a mean gauge.

name.ja: 1次元Poisson・Dirichlet/Neumann混合境界：参照・比較条件
name.en: 1D Poisson / mixed Dirichlet-Neumann boundaries — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: f=-2、左Dirichlet値1・右外向き微分2の製造解u=1+x²と比較します。
note.en: Compare with the manufactured solution u=1+x² for f=-2, left Dirichlet value one and right outward derivative two.

note.ja: 製造解 両端はゼロDirichlet条件。目標解から外力を選ぶ製造解であり、任意の外力のPoisson解ではありません。 参照カードは零Dirichletの正弦解、こちらは混合境界の1+x²です。
note.en: Manufactured solution Zero Dirichlet endpoints. The forcing is chosen from the target solution; this is not an arbitrary-source Poisson solution. The card is a zero-Dirichlet sine solution; this test uses mixed boundaries and 1+x².

name.ja: 1次元Poisson・Robin境界の製造解：参照・比較条件
name.en: 1D Poisson / Robin manufactured solutions — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: f=-exp(x)と指定Robin係数を満たすu=exp(x)が製造解です。境界処理を含む2次収束を確認します。
note.en: Use the manufactured solution u=exp(x) for f=-exp(x) and the specified Robin coefficients; check second-order convergence including boundary treatment.

note.ja: 製造解 両端はゼロDirichlet条件。目標解から外力を選ぶ製造解であり、任意の外力のPoisson解ではありません。 参照カードは零Dirichletの正弦解、こちらはRobin境界のexp(x)です。
note.en: Manufactured solution Zero Dirichlet endpoints. The forcing is chosen from the target solution; this is not an arbitrary-source Poisson solution. The card is a zero-Dirichlet sine solution; this test uses Robin boundaries and exp(x).

name.ja: 2次元Poisson・広帯域の滑らかな製造解：参照・比較条件
name.en: 2D Poisson / broad smooth manufactured forcing — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 比較資料の滑らかな製造解から選んだ右辺と、分離変数の離散直接解を区別し、連続誤差と代数誤差を確認します。
note.en: Distinguish forcing chosen from the comparison's smooth manufactured solution from a separable discrete direct solution; check continuous and algebraic errors separately.

note.ja: 製造解 両端はゼロDirichlet条件。目標解から外力を選ぶ製造解であり、任意の外力のPoisson解ではありません。 同じPoisson製造解の考え方ですが、カードは1次元単一正弦、こちらは2次元の滑らかな複合ソースです。
note.en: Manufactured solution Zero Dirichlet endpoints. The forcing is chosen from the target solution; this is not an arbitrary-source Poisson solution. Both use manufactured Poisson solutions, but the card is a 1D single sine while this test uses a smooth composite 2D source.

name.ja: 2次元Poisson・局在ソース：参照・比較条件
name.en: 2D Poisson / localized source — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 局在ソースに対する離散直接解と真の残差を基準に反復法を比較します。公開資料にこのソースの閉形式連続解は添付されていません。
note.en: Compare iterations against a discrete direct solution and true residual for the localized source. This publication attaches no closed-form continuum solution for that source.

name.ja: 2次元Poisson・一様ソース：参照・比較条件
name.en: 2D Poisson / uniform source — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 高解像度の保存変数の点値を各100/200点の格子中心へ線形補間する。誤差はそれぞれ同じ場所・t=1.8で平均する。CSVは200点の計算・参照を並べる。近似収支の許容値0.2%は固定境界の離散化誤差を許すためであり、密度誤差0.15の判定とは別。
note.en: Higher-resolution conserved point values are linearly interpolated to each 100/200-point grid's centers. Errors are averaged at matching locations and t=1.8; CSV pairs the 200-point solution and reference. The 0.2% approximate-balance allowance accommodates fixed-boundary discretization and is separate from the density-error bound of 0.15.

note.ja: 解析解 全直線上のスカラーRiemann問題のエントロピー解。端点の外側は一定値で継続します。 左右状態(1,0)、段差位置0.5、端点継続が一致します。点値とセル平均の評価は区別します。 物理的な入力は一致しますが、参照カードの点値標本と保存計算の有限体積セル平均・離散格子は別表現です。
note.en: Analytic reference Entropy solution of a scalar whole-line Riemann problem; constant endpoint continuation. States (1,0), jump position 0.5 and endpoint continuation match; distinguish point and cell-average evaluation. Physical inputs match, but the card’s point samples and the saved computation’s finite-volume cell averages/discrete grid are different representations.

The differential equation is not the discrete logistic map. Scoped executed example: One dimensionless population. Compare RK4 with the analytic solution at every output time; check nonnegativity and time refinement. Excludes reaction–diffusion and multispecies models. Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters.

note.ja: 閉じた一様混合集団の規格化SIR系。SEIRは曝露区画を追加します。人数と割合ではβの定義が異なります。 限定した実行例：閉鎖・均質な人口割合SIR。RK4と別実装のSciPy DOP853を比較。人口保存・非負性・時間収束を確認。SEIR・空間伝播・実データ較正は対象外。 この問題に関連する代表式です。初期条件・境界条件・パラメータは「図と問題の条件・根拠」と各実行例で確認できます。
note.en: Closed, well-mixed normalized population fractions. SEIR adds an exposed compartment and a progression rate. The original general epidemic framework is broader than this SIR specialization. Population-count and fraction conventions give different β definitions. Scoped executed example: Closed homogeneous population-fraction SIR. Compare RK4 with independently implemented SciPy DOP853; check conservation, nonnegativity and time convergence. Excludes SEIR, spatial spread and calibration to observations. Compare RK4 with the analytic solution at every output time; check nonnegativity and time refinement. Excludes reaction–diffusion and multispecies models.

note.ja: 酵素・基質・複合体の反応と飽和速度則。完全反応系、迅速平衡近似、準定常近似の違いは解説先へ。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Enzyme saturation; the full mass-action system resolves the transient complex C, while the rate law eliminates a fast variable. The 1913 rapid-equilibrium interpretation and the 1925 quasi-steady-state derivation must remain distinct. Literature-only.

note.ja: 捕食・被食の結合ODE。位相平面と長時間積分を考えるためのモデルです。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Coupled prey growth and predation; a phase-plane and long-time integration test.  Literature-only.

note.ja: 年齢aに沿う輸送と死亡、新生個体の非局所な更新境界を持つモデルです。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Individuals move through age a at unit speed; newborns enter through a nonlocal renewal boundary. This is the classical age-transport form; the later von Foerster lineage is acknowledged without treating its date as the first appearance. Literature-only.

note.ja: 閉じた一様混合集団の規格化SIR系。SEIRは曝露区画を追加します。人数と割合ではβの定義が異なります。 限定した実行例：閉鎖・均質な人口割合SIR。RK4と別実装のSciPy DOP853を比較。人口保存・非負性・時間収束を確認。SEIR・空間伝播・実データ較正は対象外。
note.en: Closed, well-mixed normalized population fractions. SEIR adds an exposed compartment and a progression rate. The original general epidemic framework is broader than this SIR specialization. Population-count and fraction conventions give different β definitions. Scoped executed example: Closed homogeneous population-fraction SIR. Compare RK4 with independently implemented SciPy DOP853; check conservation, nonnegativity and time convergence. Excludes SEIR, spatial spread and calibration to observations.

note.ja: 拡散と増殖を結ぶ侵入前線。表示は規格化した代表形で、波の速度と境界条件は解説先へ。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Spatial spread of an invading population or advantageous allele, represented by a reaction–diffusion front. Fisher–KPP is a conventional family name; the independent KPP 1937 original remains an archival follow-up. The exact special speed is not the minimal speed. Literature-only.

note.ja: 基質S、菌体X、収率Y、希釈率dの代表形。d=0の閉鎖バッチとケモスタットを区別します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Nutrient-limited biomass X, substrate S, yield Y and chemostat dilution d; d=0 gives a closed batch model. This writes one constant-yield extension of saturation growth, not a universal metabolic model. Literature-only.

note.ja: 電位とゲート変数z=m,h,nの膜モデル。元のイカ軸索モデルと、人心筋や空間ケーブルへの拡張を区別します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Voltage and gating variables z=m,h,n describe an ionic excitable membrane. A cable extension adds spatial axial current. The original squid-axon model is not a calibrated human cardiac model. No single rate parameter set is selected by this survey. Literature-only.

note.ja: 2成分反応拡散の枠組み。f・gは個別に指定する必要があり、模様の画像だけでTuring機構とは判定できません。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。
note.en: A framework for diffusion-driven pattern onset around a homogeneous reaction equilibrium, not a unique choice of f and g. A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

note.ja: 高速の興奮と低速の回復を結ぶ規格化した代表形。係数・符号・空間拡張には複数の規約があります。 限定した実行例：公開実行例はD=0の空間なしの縮約ODEです。FHN/BVP型の縮約ODEの限定検証です。HH全イオンチャネル、空間軸索、患者データ、実測電気生理の再現を含みません。
note.en: A normalized fast excitation/slow recovery model for pulses, refractoriness and spiral waves when extended in space. This is a common normalized variant; cubic coefficients, recovery signs and nondimensionalization differ between formulations. Scoped executed example: The executed case has D=0 and no spatial coordinate. Scoped verification of an FHN/BVP-style reduced ODE. It excludes full HH ion channels, spatial axons, patient data and experimental electrophysiology reproduction.

note.ja: 細胞密度が化学物質の勾配に応答する2場の代表的な縮約系。次元・境界・化学場の動態が重要です。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Cell density n drifts up a chemoattractant gradient; τc=0 gives an elliptic chemical subproblem. This is a common two-field reduction of a more detailed original formulation. Blowup thresholds depend on dimension, domain, boundary and chemical dynamics. Literature-only.

note.ja: 短距離活性化・長距離抑制の簡略代表形。飽和項や基礎生成項には複数の変種があります。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: A representative simplified short-range activation/long-range inhibition model. Source densities, saturation and baseline production vary across the model family. This simplified formula is not a verbatim transcription of every original variant. Literature-only.

name.ja: 流体・弾性構造と埋め込み境界

note.ja: 流体と変形構造の結合の入口。構造の力・構成則が別途必要で、既存の非圧縮ソルバーだけで実装済みとはなりません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Fluid coupled to a deformable structure; biological examples include valves and membranes, once a force/constitutive law is supplied. Immersed boundary is a numerical coupling method, not itself a closed biological constitutive equation. The existing periodic MAC solver does not implement this coupling. Literature-only.

name.ja: 化学マスター方程式とGillespie SSA
name.en: Chemical master equation and Gillespie SSA

note.ja: 整数分子数n、反応ジャンプνj、傾向関数ajの確率モデル。Gillespie SSAは軌道を標本化する解法で、反応網自体とは区別します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Integer molecule counts, reaction jumps νj and propensities aj; SSA samples paths of this continuous-time Markov model. The 1977 paper is a foundational SSA reference, not a priority claim for all master equations. SSA is a solver; the reaction network is the model. A seed documents a trajectory, not an ensemble validation. Literature-only.

name.ja: Mackey–Glass遅延生理フィードバック

note.ja: 遅延を持つフィードバックODE。初期値1点だけでなく、遅延区間の履歴関数が必要です。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Delayed feedback in a normalized physiological control model; delay can change stability and oscillatory behavior. A scalar initial value alone is insufficient. The delayed ODE is distinct from a spatial reaction–diffusion model. Literature-only.

name.ja: レプリケータ進化ゲーム動態

note.ja: 利得行列Aに対する戦略割合の動態。定常点と進化的安定戦略の同一視はしません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Strategy fractions reproduce according to relative payoff in a specified matrix game. No universal Lyapunov function or equivalence of fixed point and evolutionarily stable strategy is assumed. Literature-only.

note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

note.ja: 自己拡散・交差拡散と競争を含む系。表示は環境ポテンシャルを省いた一様環境での縮約形です。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Competition with density-dependent self- and cross-dispersal can produce spatial segregation. The displayed homogeneous-environment reduction omits the original environmental-potential terms. It is not equivalent to two independent scalar diffusion equations. Literature-only.

note.ja: 流入・除去を持つ自己触媒反応拡散。斑点分裂の画像だけで細胞分裂や線形Turing不安定性とは判定しません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: A chemical feed/decay model whose spatial extension supports diverse spot and wave patterns. 1983 is the well-mixed CSTR source; Pearson 1993 is the spatial pattern reference. Spot division does not by itself demonstrate cell division or a linear Turing instability. Literature-only.

note.ja: 心筋波の興奮・回復を表す現象論的な2変数モデル。単・双領域の組織モデルは追加の構成を要します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: A reduced phenomenological excitation/recovery model for cardiac waves and restitution. Monodomain/bidomain tissue models add conductivity tensors and, for bidomain, an extracellular elliptic constraint. They are not automatically included by this two-variable model. Literature-only.

name.ja: Repressilator mRNA・タンパク質回路

note.ja: 3遺伝子の環状抑制。mRNAとタンパク質を残す6変数形で、振動の有無はパラメータに依存します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Three repressing genes form a cyclic network; retaining mRNA and protein gives six state variables. The six-variable form is distinct from a reduced three-protein oscillator; oscillations are parameter-dependent. Literature-only.

name.ja: 遺伝子トグルスイッチ

note.ja: 相互抑制による規格化した2変数遺伝子スイッチ。任意のHill指数・生成率で双安定になるとは限りません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Mutual repression produces a possible bistable genetic switch in a normalized model. Bistability is not guaranteed for arbitrary Hill exponents or production rates. Induction, mRNA dynamics and noise are additional model choices. Literature-only.

name.ja: 代数的マルチグリッド（AMG）
この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: 各行の最大非対角係数に対する相対強度からグラフを作り、貪欲な星型集約と余剰節点の隣接集約への付着で暫定補間Tを作ります。P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T、ω=4/(3ρ̄)、ρ̄はD⁻¹Aの絶対行和上界です。粗演算子はPᵀAP。前後2回のJacobi平滑化と最終小行列の直接解を用います。これは採用した小規模SA変種であり、原著の全構築法や収束定理の再現ではありません。
note.en: A graph based on row-relative off-diagonal strength supplies greedy star aggregates; leftover nodes attach to adjacent aggregates. Smooth tentative T via P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T with ω=4/(3ρ̄), where ρ̄ bounds the absolute row sums of D⁻¹A. Coarse operators are PᵀAP. V-cycles use two pre/post Jacobi sweeps and a terminal dense direct solve. This is a small adopted SA variant, not every construction or convergence theorem in the original paper.

name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: Householder反射を左から蓄積してRを上三角化し、Qを構成します。Jacobi SVDは列対の内積を小さくする直交回転を繰り返し、回転した列の長さを特異値とします。AᵀAを作って固有値を求める方法ではありません。最小二乗はQRの後退代入、階数落ちでは打切りSVDで求めます。
note.en: Householder reflectors triangularize R while accumulating Q. The SVD repeatedly rotates column pairs toward orthogonality and uses their resulting lengths as singular values; it does not diagonalize AᵀA. Least squares uses triangular back substitution for QR and truncated compact SVD for deficient rank.

name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: Lanczosの3項漸化式に2回の全再直交化を加え、Arnoldiは修正Gram–Schmidtを2回行います。小さな射影行列T/HだけをNumPyのeigh/eigで解き、元空間へRitzベクトルを戻します。大きな元行列の密固有値計算は参照側だけで使います。
note.en: Lanczos uses its three-term recurrence plus two passes of full reorthogonalization; Arnoldi uses two-pass modified Gram–Schmidt. Only the small projected T/H is solved by NumPy eigh/eig before lifting Ritz vectors. A full dense solve of the original matrix is used only on the reference side.

name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: Golub–Welschで対称Jacobi行列の固有値を節点、最初の固有ベクトル成分の平方の2倍を重みとします。適応Simpsonは区間を二分し、|S左+S右−S全|/15を局所推定として公差を配分します。評価回数と深さの上限を持ち、未達を成功としません。
note.en: Golub–Welsch obtains nodes from a symmetric Jacobi matrix and weights from twice the squared first eigenvector components. Adaptive Simpson bisects intervals and allocates tolerances using |Sleft+Sright−Swhole|/15 as a local estimate. Evaluation and depth limits report unmet targets explicitly.

name.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 独立NumPy/SciPy参照、行列再構成・直交性・特異値・階数・最小二乗残差を確認します。PDEの参照解カードとは別の線形代数検証です。 別版では条件数、右辺摂動、数値階数の閾値を変え、残差と係数の前進誤差を分けます。LAPACKと実際の二進入力から作る高精度参照の役割を区別し、QR／SVD全般や任意の悪条件行列の保証にはしません。
note.en: Check independent NumPy/SciPy references, reconstruction, orthogonality, singular values, rank and least-squares residuals. This is linear-algebra validation rather than a PDE reference-solution card. A separate release varies conditioning, right-hand-side perturbations and numerical-rank thresholds while separating residual from coefficient forward error. Distinguish LAPACK from high-precision references built from actual binary input; no general QR/SVD or arbitrary ill-conditioned-matrix guarantee is implied.

name.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 独立固有値参照と、各Ritz値・固有対の残差、直交性と反復収束を確認します。 別版では固有値間隔・非正規性・Krylov次元を分け、小さな残差と真の固有値誤差を区別します。近接固有値の部分空間比較を、個別ベクトルの精度や他の物理モデルの検証と同一視しません。
note.en: Check independent eigenvalue references together with Ritz/eigenpair residuals, orthogonality and iterative convergence. A separate release separates spectral spacing, nonnormality and Krylov dimension, distinguishing small residuals from true eigenvalue errors. A clustered-subspace comparison does not certify individual vectors or another physical model.

name.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ：参照・比較条件
name.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 多項式モーメントの既知積分値と独立求積参照を使い、厳密性・推定誤差・評価回数制限を確認します。 別版では求積点数・許容誤差と相殺の感度を比較し、真の積分誤差と内部の推定誤差を区別します。狭い山を見逃す対照も診断対象であり、診断の合格は積分推定の成功と同じではありません。
note.en: Use known polynomial integrals and independent quadrature references to check exactness, estimated errors and evaluation budgets. A separate release compares rule order, tolerance and cancellation sensitivity while distinguishing true integration error from the internal estimate. A missed narrow bump is an intended diagnostic; passing that diagnostic does not mean the integral estimate succeeded.

name.ja: 行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける：参照・検証
name.en: Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error — references and checks

note.ja: 正規化残差、SciPy spsolveとの相対解差、連続正弦解への離散L²型誤差、観測次数、operator complexityを保存します。節点順を無作為に置き換えた行列も直接解と照合し、幾何学的な粗格子を暗黙に使っていないことを確認します。反復予算0は未収束と報告します。
note.en: Store normalized residuals, relative solution differences against SciPy spsolve, discrete-L²-type continuum errors, observed order and operator complexity. A randomly permuted matrix is also checked against a direct solution to expose hidden geometric ordering assumptions. A zero cycle budget reports nonconvergence.

note.ja: 製造解 両端はゼロDirichlet条件。目標解から外力を選ぶ製造解であり、任意の外力のPoisson解ではありません。 カードは1次元sin(πx)、こちらは2次元sin(πx)sin(πy)です。次元・右辺・FEMの誤差ノルムは異なります。
note.en: Manufactured solution Zero Dirichlet endpoints. The forcing is chosen from the target solution; this is not an arbitrary-source Poisson solution. The card is 1D sin(πx); this test is 2D sin(πx)sin(πy). Dimension, forcing and FEM error norms differ.

name.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗：参照・検証
name.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares — references and checks

note.ja: QR/SVDの相対再構成誤差、Q/U/Vの直交性、SciPy LAPACK gesddの特異値、gelsd/gelsyの最小二乗解・階数、正規方程式の停留残差を比較します。特異ベクトルの符号は比較せず、零行列と予算切れも検査します。
note.en: Compare QR/SVD relative reconstruction, Q/U/V orthogonality, singular values from SciPy LAPACK gesdd, least-squares solutions/ranks from gelsd/gelsy and normal-equation stationarity residuals. Singular-vector signs are not compared; zero matrices and budget exhaustion are tested.

name.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束：参照・検証

note.ja: ||Av−λv||₂、独立密行列固有値との差、基底の直交性を保存し、Krylov次元を増やした末尾の改善を確認します。非対称Ritz値の単調収束は仮定しません。恒等行列のhappy breakdown、零初期ベクトル拒否、次元予算不足も検査します。
note.en: Store ||Av−λv||₂, differences from independently solved dense eigenvalues and basis orthogonality; verify final improvement as Krylov dimension grows. Nonsymmetric Ritz convergence is not assumed monotone. Tests include identity-matrix happy breakdown, zero-start rejection and insufficient dimension budgets.

name.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ：参照・検証
name.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets — references and checks

note.ja: 全指定次数の多項式モーメント、SciPy roots_legendreの節点・重みとの差、解析exp積分の次数収束、解析atan積分とSciPy quadへの一致を測ります。公差を厳しくしたときの評価数と誤差を示し、5評価の強制予算切れ、非有限関数値も検査します。
note.en: Measure polynomial moments for every chosen order, node/weight differences from SciPy roots_legendre, order refinement for the analytic exponential integral, and agreement with analytic arctangent and SciPy quad references. Store evaluation counts/errors as tolerance tightens; test forced exhaustion after five evaluations and nonfinite integrands.

name.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗
name.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares

note.ja: 実の縦長行列に対するHouseholder QRと片側Jacobi SVDを自作し、通常行列・列スケール差10⁶の行列・階数落ち行列を検査します。独立LAPACKの特異値と最小ノルム最小二乗解を照合します。
note.en: Original Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD for real tall matrices are checked on ordinary, 10⁶-column-scaled and rank-deficient inputs, against separate LAPACK singular values and minimum-norm least-squares solutions.

name.ja: QR/SVD：既定特異値・摂動増幅・数値階数
name.en: QR/SVD: prescribed spectra, perturbation gain and numerical rank

note.ja: 二進で厳密に表現できる16×4行列の条件数を1から2³⁶まで変え、再構成誤差と解誤差を分けます。実際のbinary64入力に対し別環境で実行した80/120桁参照とLAPACKを比較します。
note.en: Vary condition number from 1 to 2³⁶ for exactly representable 16×4 dyadic matrices, separating reconstruction from forward solution error. Compare LAPACK and separately executed 80/120-digit references for the actual binary64 inputs.

name.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束
name.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals

note.ja: 32・48次の対称／非対称行列でLanczosとArnoldiを自作し、Krylov次元4・8・16による最大実部の固有対の収束を測ります。行列全体を解く独立LAPACK参照と照合します。
note.en: Original Lanczos and Arnoldi on symmetric/nonsymmetric 32×32 and 48×48 matrices measure convergence of the largest-real-part eigenpair over Krylov dimensions 4, 8 and 16, against independent full-matrix LAPACK references.

name.ja: Krylov固有値：クラスター部分空間と非正規感度
name.en: Krylov eigenvalues: cluster subspaces and nonnormal sensitivity

note.ja: 48次のクラスター固有値と強い非正規上三角行列で、次元4/8/16/32のLanczos・Arnoldiを測ります。残差・前進誤差・固有値条件数・不変部分空間を分けます。
note.en: Measure Lanczos and Arnoldi with dimensions4/8/16/32 on 48-dimensional clustered symmetric and strongly nonnormal triangular matrices. Distinguish residual, forward error, eigenvalue condition number and invariant subspace.

name.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ
name.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets

note.ja: Legendreの3項漸化式からGauss節点と重みを構成し、2n−1次までの多項式モーメントと指数関数を検査します。適応Simpsonは指数関数とLorentz型ピークを積分し、解析積分・独立QUADPACKと比較します。
note.en: Construct Gaussian nodes/weights from the Legendre recurrence and test polynomial moments through degree 2n−1 and an exponential. Adaptive Simpson integrates exponential and Lorentzian peaks, against analytic integrals and independent QUADPACK.

name.ja: 求積：狭いピーク・相殺・端点・誤差推定の盲点
name.en: Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots

note.ja: Gauss次数と適応公差を走査し、狭いLorentzピーク、平方根端点、巨大な相殺、零積分、見逃すcompact bumpを解析積分とQUADPACKで検証します。
note.en: Vary Gauss order and adaptive tolerance on narrow Lorentz peaks, a square-root endpoint, severe cancellation, a zero integral and a deliberately missed compact bump, using analytic integrals and QUADPACK.

name.ja: 行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける
name.en: Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error

note.ja: 正方形Poisson問題から得たSPD行列だけを階層構築へ渡し、平滑化集約AMGのV-cycleを実行します。7²・15²・31²未知数で独立疎行列直接解、解析的な離散正弦モード、連続解への2次収束を分けて検査します。
note.en: Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution.
